svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The lid is 15 mm deep and faces the street below.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two 16.2 mm holes for the M12 expansion ports, 30 mm toward the pole

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: end from the middle, 20 mm each side of the centre line (40 apart).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill as for the box: tape, 3 mm pilot, step drill, deburr.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit each port from outside with its seal, nut inside, maker's torque.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Solder a 150 mm lead set to each port and fit a plug-in connector,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: so the lid can come off without a soldering iron.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: each port seats flat on its seal; the lid gasket is unbroken.
